items.condition: OpticStudio 24.2.0 build240529 PremiumEdition; new sequential model with 100 mm finite object distance; installed sample.SDF; native tool closed and application disconnected.
items.observation: LightSourceAnalysis settings are AS_Default with IsValid as the only writable property. Twenty-two manual-described ModifySettings key attempts returned true, but LoadFrom provided no field getters and Apply returned zero grids, series, scatter points and messages. The dedicated analysis window output identity remains unverified.
items.unlock_condition: A formal readable setting surface or a verified native CFG key/readback and output-to-input identity mapping, followed by an owned DAT/SDF reference.

items.condition: Cooke 40 degree field model; owned asymmetric 7x7 IMA placed in Images and removed after each analysis; each native analysis closed.
items.observation: Both analyses return AR_Default settings and one grid. Grid sizes observed were 256x256 and 13x13. CFG ModifySettings returned true for documented candidate keys and for a deliberately nonexistent key; therefore its boolean cannot verify key recognition or setting adoption. Grid source, data type, scale and coherence selection remain unassigned.
items.unlock_condition: Obtain a setting mechanism with verifiable key recognition/readback, then confirm file identity and image output against a deterministic independent diffraction/coherence reference.

next: PowerField/PowerPupil native POWF/POWP semantics and controlled ray reference; then the fixed candidate/reserve sequence.
